That recovery feels right. When the save failed, the pop-up didn't slam shut and lose everything I'd done — my edited title "My saved roast potatoes," the description I wrote, and the Recipes label were all still sitting right there, and it told me plainly that the save didn't go through and my details are safe, so I can just try again. And nothing half-saved snuck into my collection in the meantime — it only lands there once the save actually works.

That's exactly what I'd want when something goes wrong: don't make me retype everything, be honest that it didn't save, and don't leave a broken ghost entry behind. This is good.
